usage_example:
from integrations.ads import get_ads_platform, Campaign, BidStrategy, CampaignStatus

config = {'access_token': 'xxx', 'account_id': 'act_123'}
platform = get_ads_platform('meta', config)
platform.authenticate()
campaign = Campaign(name='My Campaign', budget=100.0, bid_strategy=BidStrategy.MAXIMIZE_CONVERSIONS)
created = platform.create_campaign(campaign)
performance = platform.get_performance(created.id)
suggestions = platform.get_optimization_suggestions(created.id)
